So I'm a makeup junkie/addict/collector and I have been putting off purchasing something like this for a while now (not sure why). I chose this one because of the price,  I didn't need anything too big and $7 wss reasonable enough for me. It's pretty thin, but I can use both sides of it for my foundation/concealer. reviews.t: This is a really cool pallet. I love it for mixing foundation and ...
reviews.x: This is a really cool pallet. I love it for mixing foundation and masks. I use to us my hand to put some foundation onto it than use a brush to put it on my face. Now i can put it on the pallet than my face. Love that. Also the spatula will be great in getting the foundation out of the bottle. This one is small but i prefer it. I didnt want a huge one. I got this at a review and love it. This would make a great unique gift of a make up lover.

reviews.t: This is great for a tiny stainless steel palette for keeping your ...
reviews.x: This is great for a tiny stainless steel palette for keeping your moisturizer and primer sanitary when applying on a client or model at shoots, or mixing foundations (I use it with the Graftobian HD Glamour creme palette). Wouldn't recommend using at a big shoot since its pretty small (about the size of a smart phone). Overall it is good for personal and portable use!

The carrying case is  fantastic!  Even has its own little compartment for the "mixing tool". Great size, for travel.  The palette is very sturdy and has a little bit of weight to it, this is  definitely a professional quality palette. I used it to mix my foundation colors and it was the  perfect size. This is something I will be using every day!

Does what it’s supposed to. I got tired of squirting foundation, B.B. creams, etc on the back of my hands before applying to face. Now I can squirt it on this and keep my hands clean I like the little mixing tool that came with it I can scrape the last drop out bottles and mix highlighters or lotion into my foundations with ease. Definitely recommend.

I'm not a fan of mixing makeup on my wrists so I use it to mix my concealers for highlighting and I pour my liquid foundation on it so that I can then dip my brush and apply it to my face.

The product was a smaller than I'd hoped( don't know much about dimensions) but it definitely does the work. It's definitely bigger than the round things used at MAC. reviews.t: I've been looking for something like this - I saw a makeup artist use one
reviews.x: I'm in between make up shades currently and I have been using the back of my hand to mix my foundation and concealer shades. I've been looking for something like this - I saw a makeup artist use one. It's the perfect size - can fit in your makeup bag for traveling and easy to clean. It comes with a few extra tools too! Great price!

reviews.t: Perfect, weighty little handheld palette for mixing foundations
reviews.x: Perfect, weighty little handheld palette for mixing foundations. I usually have to combine shades and was doing so off the back of my hand, but this is a much tidier option and doesn't waste any product. The little spatula is such a nice bonus! Product was a little shinier than I was anticipating, but it doesn't affect the quality.

LOVE!! I'm a makeup fanatic- I saw one of the gurus I follow on youtube use one, and figured how nice it would be to have instead of using my hand all the time. SO WORTH IT! I am using half the pump of what I use to use. It is saving me so much extra money!! So worth it to save on high end foundations/cc creams!!!

Exactly as pictured. Comes in a nice holder. Great quality. Works well for applying my foundation. I put foundation on the palette, dip my brush in it, and buff it onto my face. This way, the foundation doesn't dry on your skin as quickly so you can evenly spread it out. Love it! Came very quickly as well.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the palette's size, describing it as small enough to store in a makeup bag yet large enough for mixing products.
Many customers value the included spatula and the palette's usefulness for hygienic makeup mixing and transferring products.
Several reviewers highlight the good value and price compared to alternatives.
A few reviewers mention the palette works well for mixing foundation and creating custom shades.
One reviewer warns that the edges can be sharp and cut hands, especially when washing.
